mentions.name: buyvds.net
mentions.description: A website offering a global visual interface listing around 249 VPS providers across 60 countries, combining up to 863 links (a provider can offer VPS in multiple countries). It exposes a SQL query interface on the website itself via DuckDB so visitors can explore the data, and includes a "john mode" view based on a friend's suggestion.
